about: The last 24 hours of IPMA's hourly station observations, as arrays in the order of 'hours'. t: air temperature (°C, mean of the hour); w: wind speed at 10 m (km/h; the mean, not gusts: IPMA's open data carries no gusts); d: wind direction class (1 or 9 N, 2 NE, 3 E, 4 SE, 5 S, 6 SW, 7 W, 8 NW); r: precipitation in the hour (mm); h: relative humidity (%); p: pressure at sea level (hPa). null is IPMA's -99.0 (no data). The hour label's convention is not documented by IPMA (see api.json).
label: fact: IPMA's values, reshaped by us; computed fields say so
hour_label: as IPMA writes it: no zone, and IPMA does not say whether the hour starts or ends at the label
